title: Western Star 6964 Road Train FUPS compliant Custom Bull Bar #2
description: Western Star 6964 hi-tensile aluminium polished FUPS Bullbar. Five post design with the main box uprights extended to the bottom of the main channel to the Cow catcher fitted with four small uprights. Road Train signs with WS covers, Built with 88mm diameter pipe. Custom driving light mounts as required plus light bar mounts to the top centre pipe. Combination LED indicator/daylight running/park repeater lights custom fitted to outer uprights. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin. Front mudflap bar standard. Custom engraved logos in main channel end plates.
